# Provenance and License Inventory

Every third-party or reference-derived item in this repository is listed here. "Pattern-only"
means an idea was learned from a source; no code, schema, configuration value, fixture,
identifier or prose was copied.

## Vendored or generated files

| Path | Source | Revision | License | Transformation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.specify/scripts/**`, `.specify/templates/**`, `.specify/workflows/**`, `.specify/integrations/**`, `.specify/integration.json`, `.specify/init-options.json`, `.specify/.gitignore`, `.specify/memory/.constitution-template.json` | [github/spec-kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit) | `v1.2.3` = `5ea8b1cf0a38699340a38e00d02770308997d8c0` | MIT | Generated by `specify init` (pinned); verified by `tools/speckit/bootstrap.sh verify` |
| `.claude/skills/speckit-*/SKILL.md` | github/spec-kit | same | MIT | Generated by `specify init --integration claude` |
| `.specify/memory/constitution.md` | Spec Kit constitution template | same | MIT (template) | Structure from the template; content authored for this project |

The upstream MIT license text is at `.specify/LICENSE`, taken from the pinned commit.
